summary: End-to-end backend test of the NEW Service Providers Directory (Module 2) against the deployed Railway backend (https://ross-house-backend-production.up.railway.app). Wrote /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_service_providers.py covering all 23 endpoints requested. Result: 23/23 PASS in 3.08s. PUBLIC endpoints verified: GET /api/public/service-providers/services returns 200 with exactly 20 services (each {id, es, en}); POST /api/public/service-providers creates provider (is_new=true), dedups on repeat (is_new=false), and returns 422 for invalid email/invalid service/short phone; GET /api/public/service-providers/check correctly reports exists=true + status='pending_review'. ADMIN endpoints verified (Bearer JWT via /api/public/marketplace-login): list/stats/search/filter by service/filter by status all work and include the QA provider; PATCH status='active' and PATCH {is_featured, admin_notes} persist (verified with follow-up GET); PATCH status='foo' → 400; POST /dispatch returns boolean email_sent/sms_sent + appends dispatch_history entry + increments total_jobs; POST /rate twice computes avg correctly (4.5 then 4.75) and increments completed_jobs; GET /export/csv returns text/csv with Spanish header (Nombre, Email, Servicios, Rating, ...) including the QA provider — NO None-formatting crash even though hourly_rate/project_rate_min/project_rate_max were None on the test provider (same risk class as iter_12 — already coded defensively with `(p.get('hourly_rate') or 0)`); GET/PUT /provider-settings returns and persists the toggleable email/SMS flags + welcome templates; DELETE returns 200 and follow-up GET returns 404; unauthenticated requests to /api/admin/* return 401. Email/SMS booleans are False on Railway (credentials gated) — accepted as boolean per spec. No regressions, no critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: CSV export at /app/ross-house-backend/rental/service_providers_router.py:444 uses `(p.get('hourly_rate') or 0)` — the iter_12 None-handling fix is already applied here proactively. Good.
Public POST /public/service-providers on dedup path persists status/created_at/rating/total_jobs/admin_notes from the existing doc — correct behavior, no data loss on re-registration.
auth_admin() check is uniformly invoked at the top of every /admin/* handler — no missing auth on any route.
seed_data_creation: Fixture creates one provider per run with timestamp-suffixed email (qa.provider.20260629+<ts>@example.com) and deletes it at the end of the admin test class. No residual data on Railway.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service Providers Directory (Module 2) is fully green on Railway. Canonical regression suite: /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_service_providers.py (23 tests, ~3s). Reuses the same Bearer JWT pattern as tenant_waitlist via POST /api/public/marketplace-login. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter14_service_providers.xml. Local supervisor backend remains broken (pre-existing MONGO_URL env issue) — ignore; all tests run against the Railway URL from BACKEND_BASE_URL/env default.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The CSV None-handling risk flagged by the main agent was already mitigated in this module (defensive `(p.get('hourly_rate') or 0)` formatting). Test created a provider with no hourly_rate/project_rate to exercise that path explicitly: CSV returned 200 with text/csv content-type and the QA provider row rendered with '$0' for the hourly rate column.
